title: Amazon EventBridge pipes targets IoT Core topic
description: Create an EventBridge pipe that publishes data to an IoT Core topic

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This sample project demonstrates how to use an Amazon EventBridge pipe to publish data to an AWS IoT Core Topic. This pattern leverages the native integration between the following services: DynamoDB streams, EventBridge pipes, API Gateway, and IoT Core.
This pattern deploys one DynamoDB table, one EventBridge pipe, and one API Gateway REST API.

bullets.text: AWS Solutions Constructs for API Gateway integration to IoT Core

text: See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
